name: Academics
description: Issues related to attendance, certificates, examination, letters, learning material, projects, viva, and other academic matters.

name: Facilities
description: Issues related to hostel facilities including carpentry, electrical, housekeeping, plumbing, security, and others.

name: Finance
description: Issues related to fees and other finance matters.

name: Food and Beverage
description: Issues related to food and beverage services on campus.

name: IT
description: Issues related to admin portal, G-Suite, group creation, ID card, internet connectivity, learning platform, Microsoft Office, online library access, and others.

name: Stores Request
description: Material requisition from stores for canteen, central kitchen, training center, or boys mess.

name: PACE
description: Issues related to admission, academics, degree and certificate, examination/result, fee-related, grievance, technical issues, and transcripts for PACE students.

name: Library Book Request
description: Request for a specific library book by accession number, title, and author.

name: OOR Intimation
description: Out of Residence intimation — arriving late, night out, or out of station. No approval required; ticket auto-closes on submission.

name: Electric Appliance Declaration
description: Declaration of electric appliance in room. No approval required; ticket auto-closes on submission.

name: Nominations
description: Self-nomination for a student body post with statement of purpose.

name: SBA Committee Application
description: Application to join an SBA committee — includes three questions and comments.

name: Attendance Condonation Under AER
description: Application for attendance condonation under AER for medical, bereavement, critical illness, or menstrual leave reasons.

name: Grade
description: Issues related to grades for a specific subject.

name: Electives
description: Issues related to elective course selection or matters.

name: Roommate Intimation
description: Roommate preference intimation for hostel room allocation. Does not constitute confirmation of room-mate or room allotment.

name: Travel & Transportation
description: Request for campus vehicle / driver for official or personal travel — includes trip details, driver and car assignment, and trip log (KM, time, charges).
